stem: How does the setting of the library influence Carol's belief that all things make sense?

options.label: A
options.text: The setting provides Carol with a quiet place to reflect on her beliefs.

options.label: B
options.text: The setting causes Carol to doubt her beliefs when she realizes that the mysterious book has changed.

options.label: C
options.text: The setting helps Carol realize that her beliefs have restricted her from enjoying all that life has to offer.

options.label: D
options.text: The setting gives Carol a place to think about how her dreams have changed her beliefs.

visual_elements: Four answer choices each labeled A, B, C, D
